message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" dated "9-15 DESEMBER 2013" features two central figures against a white background. On the left, a man is rendered in a black-and-white hatched sketching style. He wears a light-colored button-down shirt. His right hand is raised, covering his eyes, while his left hand holds a small red dart with a feathered tail, poised to throw. He is shown from the chest up, facing right with a wide, open-mouthed smile.

To the right, a smaller figure of a woman with glasses and dark hair peeks out from behind a large, circular target. The target is yellow with black concentric rings and appears to be made of a flat material. The woman has a concerned facial expression and grips the edge of the target with her right hand.

The masthead "TEMPO" appears in large red capital letters at the top. Other legible text includes "JEJARING KORUPSI AKIL MOCHTAR," "JAKARTA-BANDUNG BERSAMA MANDELA," and the main headline "DI BAWAH LINDUNGAN DAHLAN." Smaller text below reads "Tanpa tender, orang dekat Menteri BUMN mendapat jatah pengelolaan ladang minyak Pertamina." A barcode and price "RP 33.000" are in the bottom left corner. The names "Dahlan Iskan dan Karen Agustiawan" are printed in the bottom right.
